enabled.description: Answer unmatched phrases with an AI. Turn off and unmatched phrases are simply ignored.

max_tokens.description: Ceiling on reply length. Lower is faster and cheaper.

history_turns.description: How many previous exchanges to send as context. Higher costs more per call.

openai_key.description: OpenAI API key. Note that OpenAI has no free tier - the account needs credit on it. Stored in your .env file, not here.

system_prompt.default: You are the voice assistant for a wall-mounted home display. Answer in a few short sentences unless asked for detail. You are being read aloud and shown on a small screen, so avoid long lists. Use markdown for code, links and emphasis. If you do not know something, say so briefly.
system_prompt.value: You are the voice assistant for a wall-mounted home display. Answer in a few short sentences unless asked for detail. You are being read aloud and shown on a small screen, so avoid long lists. Use markdown for code, links and emphasis. If you do not know something, say so briefly.
system_prompt.description: Sent to the AI before every conversation, telling it what it is and how to reply.

speak_replies.description: Read replies aloud as well as showing them, when TTS is available.

panel_timeout.description: How long the chat panel stays open with no interaction. Deliberately long, so a conversation is not cut off mid-thought.
